## About
A/C Control is a family-owned, locally owned HVAC contractor based on Westwood Blvd. We handle residential heating and air conditioning, commercial systems, and industrial HVAC, cooling tower and ventilation engineering.
The company is led by Marzi Eghtesadi and Babak Firoozi, both registered Professional Engineers with the State of California. They work hand-in-hand on temperature control projects, from adding central air to an older home to redesigning the air conditioning of a commercial factory.
Our mission is to provide exceptional expertise and value with honesty and integrity. Customers rate us 4.8 from 341 Google reviews.

## Services
- Air Conditioning Installation & Replacement: Starts with a pre-installation checklist and in-house engineering calculations. Includes permit coordination when required, electrical and duct compatibility checks, safe removal of old equipment and complete system testing.
- Air Conditioning Repair: A full onsite diagnostic with voltage and amp checks, refrigerant level testing, airflow inspection and component evaluation. We repair capacitors, contactors, thermostats, fan motors, compressors and refrigerant leaks.
- Air Conditioning Maintenance: Seasonal tune-ups covering filter inspection, coil cleaning, refrigerant level verification, thermostat calibration, condensate drain inspection, airflow testing and safety checks.
- AC Compressor Replacement: When a compressor fails, we look at whether a compressor replacement or a full condensing unit upgrade is the better long-term fix.
- Heating Repair: Diagnostics and repairs for furnaces and heat pumps. We run safety checks, find the root cause and give you a clear written estimate before any work begins.
- Heating Installation & Replacement: Energy-efficient furnaces and heat pumps, sized after a full site assessment. We handle permit requirements and remove old equipment responsibly.
- Ductless Mini-Split Installation: Zoned comfort for room additions, garages and homes without ductwork, with minimal disruption to your home.
- Commercial HVAC: Commercial heating and air conditioning, cooling tower services, refrigeration and preventive maintenance for LA businesses.

## FAQ
Q: Are your technicians licensed?
A: Yes. Our technicians are licensed, insured and professionally trained to deliver accurate diagnostics.

Q: Should I repair or replace my system?
A: It depends on the system. A repair often makes sense when the issue involves a single component. Replacement may be recommended after repeated breakdowns or a major compressor failure. Our goal is the right long-term decision, not the fastest fix.

Q: What is the A/C Control Club?
A: Our maintenance plan. Membership includes scheduled tune-ups, priority scheduling during heat waves and cold snaps, preferred pricing on parts and repairs, and remote monitoring options. We'll walk you through the plan options.

Q: Which neighborhoods do you serve?
A: Homeowners across Los Angeles, including Downtown LA, Hollywood, Echo Park, West LA, Culver City and the surrounding neighborhoods.

Q: Can I get a free estimate?
A: Yes. Fill out the estimate request form and we will get back to you with the information you need.
